program.department: Herbert Wertheim School of Public Health

notes: Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/PH-ug.html. Lower-division 32-33 units, upper-division 48 units. PH 140-191 ranges are the catalog's own shorthand and are kept as-is.

buckets.label: Introductory Biology (three courses)
buckets.note: Choose three BILD courses from this list

buckets.label: Lower-division PH elective (Public Health Elements)
buckets.note: One 4-unit lower-division PH course from PH 50-95, PH 98, or PH 99

buckets.label: Public health core (Core Disciplines)
buckets.note: PH 101, PH 102, PH 110, PH 120, PH 130 (R variants substitute for their base course); 20 units

buckets.label: PH major elective (selection)
buckets.note: One course from PH 140-191, PH 195P, PH 198, or PH 199 (completes the 12-unit Public Health Perspectives block with PH 157/180)

buckets.label: Public Health electives
buckets.note: Eight additional units from public health perspectives or the approved elective list

buckets.label: Capstone / practicum
buckets.note: PH 193/193R + PH 194/194R (8 units), OR the honors sequence PH 196AH + PH 196BH (12 units)
